about.title: Huraymila Healthy City Program
about.subtitle: Leading national initiative within the Saudi Healthy Cities Program
about.description:
The Huraymila Healthy City Program is a national developmental and health initiative dedicated to implementing healthy city standards in the Huraymila Governorate. The program operates within the framework of the Saudi Healthy Cities Program through an integrated collaborative framework involving governmental, non-profit, private, and local community sectors.

Huraymila Governorate was officially registered under the Healthy Cities Program on November 30, 2021. Since then, the program has worked to organize and empower collaborative efforts, promote qualitative initiatives, and enhance the efficiency of health and developmental indicators, contributing to improving quality of life and achieving community sustainability.

The program operates under the supervision of His Excellency the Governor of Huraymila, Chairman of the Main Committee, with support and coordination from the Coordination Office, and with the participation of 18 governmental, non-profit, and charitable organizations. The work is executed through specialized committees responsible for implementing initiatives, tracking indicators, uploading evidence, and completing accreditation requirements to ensure a sustainable environment and comprehensive health awareness.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To make Huraymila a model healthy city that achieves the highest standards of quality of life for its residents and visitors, and contributes to achieving Saudi Vision 2030.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To develop and implement innovative and sustainable health initiatives that enhance community health and well-being through effective partnership between government, private, and civil society sectors.

objectives.title: Our Strategic Objectives
list: Improve health indicators in the governorate by 30% within 3 years
Increase green spaces in the city to 40% of total area
Educate 80% of city residents about health and environmental culture
Establish a network of local and international partners
Achieve environmental sustainability in all our projects
Develop specialized training programs for healthcare workers
Create an integrated system for monitoring and evaluating health initiatives

aboutHuraymila.title: About Huraymila Governorate
aboutHuraymila.subtitle: The Jewel of Riyadh Region
aboutHuraymila.description: Huraymila Governorate is located in Riyadh region, 86 km northwest of Riyadh city. It is distinguished by its strategic location, rich heritage, and is known for agriculture and historical sites.

history.title: History & Heritage
history.description: Huraymila boasts a rich history spanning centuries, having been an important stop on ancient trade routes. It is renowned for its traditional architectural heritage and archaeological sites that reflect the region's antiquity.

geography.title: Geographic Location
geography.description: Located in Riyadh region at an elevation of 650 meters above sea level, Huraymila is characterized by its moderate climate and picturesque nature that combines mountains and green plains.

economy.title: Economy & Development
economy.description: Huraymila relies on agriculture as a fundamental pillar of the local economy, in addition to heritage tourism and modern industrial development that contribute to driving development forward.

culture.title: Culture & Society
culture.description: Huraymila's community is distinguished by strong social cohesion and preservation of authentic customs and traditions, while being open to modern developments in various fields.

features.scenicNatureDesc: Mountains and plains distinguished by their natural beauty
features.moderateClimateDesc: Moderate desert climate throughout the year
features.thrivingAgricultureDesc: High-quality wild honey production from local beehives

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about Huraymila Healthy City Program
faq.whatIsProgram: What is the Huraymila Healthy City Program?
faq.whatIsProgramAnswer: The Huraymila Healthy City Program is a comprehensive initiative aimed at improving quality of life and public health in Huraymila Governorate through promoting cooperation between government agencies, civil society organizations, and the local community.
faq.programObjectivesAnswer: The program aims to improve health indicators, promote healthy lifestyles, support community initiatives, and develop health and social infrastructure in the governorate.
faq.whoCanParticipate: Who can participate in the program?
faq.whoCanParticipateAnswer: All community members can participate in the program either as volunteers or beneficiaries of services. Government agencies, civil society organizations, and the private sector can also participate as partners.
faq.initiativeTypes: What types of initiatives are available?
faq.initiativeTypesAnswer: The program includes diverse health initiatives such as health awareness programs, free medical checkups, sports activities, healthy nutrition programs, and mental health initiatives.
faq.howToJoinInitiative: How can I join an initiative?
faq.howToJoinInitiativeAnswer: You can register for initiatives through the website or by visiting the coordination office in the governorate. We will contact you to confirm participation and provide necessary details.
faq.initiativeFees: Are there fees for participating in initiatives?
faq.initiativeFeesAnswer: Most initiatives are completely free. Some specialized activities may require symbolic fees, and participants will be informed in advance.
faq.howToVolunteer: How can I volunteer in the program?
faq.howToVolunteerAnswer: You can register as a volunteer through the volunteering page on the website or by visiting the coordination office. We will assess your skills and direct you to suitable initiatives.
faq.volunteerRequirementsAnswer: There are no special requirements for volunteering, just the desire to contribute to community service. Some initiatives may require specific skills, which will be clarified during registration.
faq.volunteerCertificate: Do I get a volunteer certificate?
faq.volunteerCertificateAnswer: Yes, volunteers receive certificates of appreciation that document volunteer hours and initiatives they participated in, helping build their resumes.
faq.environmentalInitiatives: What are the environmental initiatives in the program?
faq.environmentalInitiativesAnswer: We include afforestation programs, environmental cleanup, recycling, environmental awareness, and renewable energy programs to achieve environmental sustainability.
faq.environmentalParticipation: How can I participate in environmental activities?
faq.environmentalParticipationAnswer: You can join environmental work teams, participate in cleanup campaigns, or propose new environmental initiatives through available communication channels.
faq.trainingProgramsAnswer: We provide training courses in first aid, health awareness, community leadership, life skills, and vocational training.
faq.suggestTrainingTopic: Can I suggest a new training topic?
faq.suggestTrainingTopicAnswer: Yes, we welcome your suggestions for new training topics. You can send suggestions through the contact page or coordination office.
